corrections: Kept the two Gaius index entities separate: Acts 19:29 identifies a Macedonian Gaius; Acts 20:4 identifies Gaius of Derbe. No textual basis to merge.
Restricted Gamaliel's Acts 5 introduction to facts present at Acts 5:34; his teaching of Paul is gated to Acts 22:3.
Herod Agrippa I is the Acts 12 king; later narrative outcomes are facts gated to their later verses.
Excluded false index occurrences: Heber→ACT 23:35 is “Herod’s palace,” not the person Heber; Judas_1758→ACT 9:11 is “house of Judah,” not Judas the person.
Flagged Lebbaeus→ACT 1:13 as an indirect association: the Acts wording is Judas son of James and does not itself attest the name Lebbaeus.

Separated Acts 12 James (John’s brother), Acts 1:13 James son of Alphaeus, and the later James whose family identity Acts does not state. Separated the three John profiles and three Judas profiles by explicit textual contexts.
Separated the Israel person candidate from the collective “children of Israel” references; the Jacob links remain indirect because Acts names Jacob rather than Israel.
